propositions: Tier-2 must reconstruct and re-run Pass-1 finders on a small fixed stratified sample (~20 reviews) to evaluate criterion edits without relying on stored data alone.

Single-criterion mode (e.g. `--criteria T5c`) constructs a one-entry `req.criteria` tuple and dispatches through `ProductionBatchRunner._resolve_criteria` with real single/agent tier routing, including G3/G4 container split, not forced single-turn.

Candidate Pass-1 findings must be verified via the same `verify_findings` seam as Tier-1, then their verdict computed via `pass3_decide`, and compared to the stored verdict as a flip matrix, not per-question agreement.

Current commissioning runs show degenerate Jaccard≈0 and relieved≈19-20/20 despite repo_root code-grounding fix; the stored baseline, norm_id matching, or candidate finding set receipt may have systematic issues not yet identified.
Unit tests confirm worktree-based materialization with real source access works for individual samples, but aggregate behavior across 20 samples contradicts single-sample qualitative correctness.
Cost must stay under $60 total; 1-TURN/2-STEP criteria capped at $0.25/sample, AGENT-tier criteria priced at production rate and reported separately.
